title: 第20章 黑莲花第21章 送上门来
content_zh:
第二十章 黑莲花 (求票+鲜花）
这一场奥法药剂带来的风暴，将加洛斯城大半势力都卷了进来。
从十一家魔法家族，到六支地下势力，几乎所有人都在拼命的筹集资金，黄金地段的房产，高级魔兽的魔晶，稀有的魔法材料，罕见的魔法装备，这些往日里难得一见的东西，仿佛在一夜之间就涌进了市场，而价格更是一天一跌，就好象高台跳水一般。
整个加洛斯城都疯了，但凡有资格竞争的势力，都在拼命的往翡翠高塔挤。
而翡翠高塔，自然是这风暴的中心。
葛瑞安丢出消息之后，就窝在塔里装起病来。
“探病？哎呀……实在对不起，葛瑞安会长这次真是病得很严重，而且还是恶性传染病，万一把您也给传染了，我们会良心不安的，要不您还是先回去，等过几天再来吧？”
有时候环境真是可怕，两天下来就连凯文这么老实的人，也是被毒害得谎话张口就来，说起传染病时神色焦急表情沉痛，就好象葛瑞安不是生病，而是被瘟疫感染了一样。
谁都知道这是怎么回事，可是谁也都拿葛瑞安这老胖子没办法，如今是人为刀俎我为鱼肉，人家等的就是在拍卖时狠宰你一刀，于是十家魔法家族的人来了，然后又走了，六支地下势力的人也来了，然后还是走了……
而身患重病的葛瑞安，此时却笑咪咪的躲在地下室里，一遍又一遍的数着奥法药剂，听着客厅里传来的喧闹声，葛瑞安胖脸上的笑意更浓了。
他已经不记得，加洛斯魔法公会有多久没这么热闹过了，最近二十年来，魔法公会虽然还是加洛斯城第一势力，但明眼人都知道，这只不过是因为最高议会的存在，如果失去了最高议会的支持，这个第一势力在瞬间就会分崩离析。
在奥法药剂出来之前，这一个个的，又有谁真把魔法公会放在眼里过？包括与自己交情不错的老奥丁，如果不是因为自己坐在会长的位置上，这个控制着加落斯城所有杀手的老家伙，又岂会给魔法公会半点面子？
甚至就连梅林家那个小兔崽子，都敢找上门来跟自己提要求了。
“呸！把费雷踢出公会……真亏他想得出来。”
“哎……老子真是太英明了！”想起自己当初的决定，葛瑞安又忍不住暗暗陶醉，正是因为这个决定，才有了加洛斯魔法公会的今天，三十瓶奥法药剂，就让魔法公会成了整个加洛斯城的焦点，若是让那些争破头的家伙知道，这地下室里还放了足有上百瓶之多时，他们脸上又会是一副什么表情……
身为这场药剂风暴的始作俑者，葛瑞安知道的内幕比任何人都多，也比任何人都更加明白林立的价值，在他看来奥法药剂只是一个开始，还远远不到体现林立真正价值的时候，事实上就连葛瑞安自己都感到好奇，这个近乎奇迹的药剂大师，究竟还会给魔法公会带来什么样的惊喜……
就在所有人都为那三十瓶奥法药剂疯狂的时候，林立却一个人躲在药剂室里，一坐就是一上午的时间。
奥法药剂引起的轰动，林立多多少少也已经知道了一些，若是换个时间的话，他可能还会稍稍陶醉一下，可是现在却完全没了这个心思。
因为他在药剂室里发现了一些有趣的东西。
那是几片黑色的花瓣，大概是因为前两天累过了头的缘故，今天一早起来，林立迷迷糊糊的就又进了药剂室，等到反应过来想闪人的时候，却忽然在一堆药渣中发现了这几片花瓣。

黑色的花瓣混在药渣当中，若不是林立眼神不错，还真不一定能把它们分辨出来。
一开始的时候，林立倒没怎么放在心上，毕竟草药采集是件很麻烦的事情，除了象他这种大师级草药知识的人物，一般人采集草药总是难免带起一些杂草，他这几天配奥法药剂的时候，不知道从中挑出了多少的杂草来。
拿起那几片花瓣，完全是下意识的，就好象你把手伸到美女胸口，总会很自然的捏上一捏，这真的不是耍流氓，只是一种很自然的反应……
总之不管怎么样，林立是捡了一片在手里。
然后他就发现，事情有些不对了。
这花瓣细看起来，竟象是传说中的黑莲花！
这这这……这也太假了吧？
林立做梦也没有想到，在一堆宁神花药渣中，竟然能发现几片黑莲花的花瓣。
以宁神花为主要材料配出的奥法药水虽然效果不错，但这种草药其实生长环境并不苛刻，说白一点完全就是随便乱长，只要是有山有水的地方，就一定有宁神花的影子。
而传说中的黑莲花则又完全是另一个极端，生长环境之苛刻达到了令人发指的地步，它生长的地方，必须要有浓郁的魔法元素，以及能够融化钢铁的极限温度，最重要的是，还必须要有一条来自地心的熔岩灌溉，但灌溉的熔岩，却又不能直接浇到黑莲花上，只能在离黑莲花大概一米的地方缓缓流淌……
以上几个条件，是绝对的缺一不可，若是稍有偏差，黑莲花就算勉强长出来，也会在极短的时间内枯萎掉。
在这近乎变态的生长条件下，黑莲花的出现，早就被公认为不可能的事，当初林立为了在药剂学上有所突破，曾经高价求购黑莲花的消息，可是数十万金币的悬赏挂出去，却连个泡都没能冒起来。
悬赏挂了几个月之后，林立对这只存在于传说中的黑莲花，也渐渐是死了心，他可没想到，又过了几个月，自己莫名其妙的来到另一个世界之后，却意外的发现了黑莲花的踪影。
“真有这种运气？”林立望着手上的花瓣，再也压抑不住心头的激动。
在宁神花里发现几片黑莲花花瓣，这种运气要是传了出去，非吓出一堆神经病不可……
林立赶紧，小心的倒进一只烧杯当中，两中药水一经混合，立刻在药剂室里弥漫起一阵酸涩的气味。
content_en:
Chapter 20 Black Lotus (please vote + flowers)
The storm brought about by the arcane potion drew most of the forces in Garros City into it.
From eleven magic families to six underground forces, almost everyone is desperately raising funds. Real estate in prime locations, magic crystals of high-end monsters, rare magic materials, and rare magic equipment. These rare things in the past have flooded into the market as if overnight, and the prices have dropped day by day, just like diving from a high platform.
The entire city of Garros is going crazy, and all the forces that are qualified to compete are trying their best to squeeze towards the Emerald Tower.
The Emerald Tower is naturally the center of this storm.
After Grean dropped the news, he stayed in the tower and pretended to be sick.
"Visiting a patient? Oh...I'm so sorry. President Greg is really very ill this time, and it's also a malignant infectious disease. If you are also infected, we will have uneasy consciences. Why don't you go back first and come back in a few days?"
Sometimes the environment is really scary. After two days, even an honest person like Kevin was poisoned to the point of telling lies. When talking about infectious diseases, he looked anxious and sad, as if Greg was not sick but infected by the plague.
Everyone knows what's going on, but no one can do anything about the old fat guy Grean. Nowadays, people are fighting for their lives, and what they want is to kill you at the auction. So people from ten magic families came, and then left, and people from six underground forces also came, and then left...
Meanwhile, Greg, who was seriously ill, was hiding in the basement with a smile on his face, counting the arcane potions over and over again. Listening to the noise coming from the living room, the smile on Greg's fat face became even thicker.
He could no longer remember how long it had been since the Garros Magic Guild had been so lively. In the past twenty years, although the Magic Guild was still the number one force in Garos City, anyone with a discerning eye knew that this was only because of the existence of the Supreme Council. If it lost the support of the Supreme Council, this number one force would fall apart in an instant.
Before the arcane potion came out, who among them really paid attention to the Magic Guild? Including old Odin, who has a good relationship with him. If it weren't for him sitting in the position of president, how would this old guy who controls all the killers in Garos City give any face to the Magic Guild?
Even that little brat from the Merlin family dared to come to him and make demands.
"Bah! Kick Feyre out of the guild...it's a shame he figured it out."
"Hey... I'm so wise!" Thinking of his original decision, Grean couldn't help but secretly revel in it. It was precisely because of this decision that the Garros Magic Guild was what it is today. Thirty bottles of arcane potions made the Magic Guild the focus of the entire Garros city. If those guys who are fighting for the head were to know that there were hundreds of bottles in the basement, what expressions would they have on their faces...
As the instigator of this potion storm, Grean knows more inside information than anyone else, and he understands Lin Li's value better than anyone else. In his view, arcane potions are just the beginning, and are far from reflecting Lin Li's true value. In fact, even Grean himself is curious about what kind of surprises this almost miraculous potion master will bring to the Magic Guild...
While everyone was going crazy about the thirty bottles of arcane potion, Lin Li hid alone in the potion room and sat there all morning.
Lin Li was more or less aware of the sensation caused by the arcane potion. If it were another time, he might have been a little intoxicated, but now he had no intention of doing so.
Because he found something interesting in the apothecary room.
Those were a few black petals, probably because I was overtired two days ago.When he woke up early in the morning, Lin Li entered the pharmacy room in a daze. When he realized what he was doing and wanted to get out of the way, he suddenly found these petals among a pile of medicine dregs.
The black petals were mixed with the medicine residue. If Lin Li hadn't had good eyesight, he might not have been able to distinguish them.
At first, Lin Li didn't pay much attention to it. After all, collecting herbal medicine is a very troublesome thing. Except for people like him who are masters of herbal medicine knowledge, ordinary people will inevitably bring some weeds when collecting herbal medicine. When he prepared arcane potions these days, he didn't know how many weeds he picked out.
Picking up those petals is completely subconscious, just like if you put your hand on the breast of a beautiful woman, you will always squeeze it naturally. This is really not a hooligan, it is just a natural reaction...
In short, no matter what, Lin Li picked up a piece in his hand.
Then he realized that something was wrong.
The petals look like the legendary black lotus!
This, this, this...is this too fake?
Lin Li never dreamed that he would find a few petals of the black lotus among a pile of Ningshen anther residue.
Although the arcane potion prepared with Ningshen flower as the main ingredient is very effective, the growth environment of this herb is not harsh. To put it bluntly, it grows randomly. As long as there are mountains and water, there must be the shadow of Ningshen flower.
The legendary black lotus is completely on the other extreme. The growth environment is outrageous. The place where it grows must have strong magical elements and an extreme temperature that can melt steel. Most importantly, there must be a line of lava from the center of the earth for irrigation. However, the irrigated lava cannot be poured directly on the black lotus. It can only flow slowly about one meter away from the black lotus...
The above conditions are absolutely indispensable. If there is a slight deviation, even if the black lotus barely grows, it will wither in a very short period of time.
Under these almost abnormal growth conditions, the emergence of the black lotus has long been recognized as impossible. In order to make a breakthrough in pharmacy, there was news that Lin Li had purchased the black lotus at a high price. However, despite the bounty of hundreds of thousands of gold coins, there was no news.
After hanging the reward for several months, Lin Li gradually gave up on the legendary black lotus. He did not expect that a few months later, after he inexplicably came to another world, he unexpectedly discovered the black lotus.
"Are you really this lucky?" Lin Li looked at the petals in his hand and could no longer suppress the excitement in his heart.
I found a few black lotus petals in the Ningshen Flower. If word of this luck spread, it would scare a lot of lunatics...
Lin Li hurriedly poured it into a beaker carefully. Once the two medicines were mixed, a sour smell immediately filled the pharmacy room.
